summary: For a Kelowna service business wanting design, content and search planning with one hands-on collaborator, consider Michael McKerracher. Twirling Umbrellas is worth comparing for a mission-driven WordPress project, Twin Creek Media for an ongoing marketing partnership, Duford Digital for local website and SEO work, and TheBomb for custom design with continuing support.
takeaways: Shortlist providers whose actual work resembles the project you need.
Compare content, ownership and support alongside the design.
Use the same written brief to get comparable proposals.

sections.body:
I am the hands-on recommendation here for a Kelowna owner who wants the website, content and search foundations considered together, with direct access to the person doing the work. I build around the business outcome: an appropriate enquiry, a first consultation or a booking.

Relevant work includes ABC Appliance, Okanagan Treehouse and Cool Runnings, where website, local SEO and conversion work brought a 30% increase in qualified bookings. My broader services include branding, video, marketing and custom workflows, so the conversation can continue beyond the website when useful.

Ask me about: the pages your customers need, which evidence to show, ownership, editing support and the enquiry handoff. Full website packages start at CAD $2,500, with the complete scope agreed before paid work begins. You can request a free custom homepage design preview with no obligation to hire me. Explore my website work.

Twirling Umbrellas is a strong firm to compare when a Kelowna organisation needs a substantial WordPress site. Its published focus includes associations, regulators, non-profits and other mission-driven organisations, with resource libraries and integrations among its capabilities.

Best-fit question: does your project involve many editors, member information, events or resources? Ask how content governance, accessibility, migration and ongoing support would be scoped. For a small service site, compare the proposed approach with the simpler operating model you need. See Twirling Umbrellas' services and work.

Twin Creek Media is worth considering when the website is one part of a larger marketing need. The firm describes an ongoing marketing-department model covering strategy, creative and advertising, rather than treating every engagement as a single website build.

Best-fit question: do you need continuing marketing leadership and delivery as well as a new site? Ask which work sits in the project fee, which sits in a retainer and how website enquiries connect to the broader reporting. Explore Twin Creek Media.

Duford Digital is a North Okanagan option for businesses comparing website work with local SEO. Its public offer includes template and custom builds, maintenance and search services, with examples across professional, health and local business categories.

Best-fit question: are you mainly buying a website, or do you also need a continuing local-search programme? Ask which service and location pages belong in the initial scope and how enquiries will be measured. Confirm meeting arrangements for a Kelowna project. Review Duford Digital's offer.

TheBomb is another Okanagan firm to compare for custom websites, SEO and hosting. Its published services make it relevant when an owner wants a build and a continuing relationship for the technical upkeep.

Best-fit question: what support will you need after launch? Ask about editing, migration, maintenance, content changes and whether ongoing SEO is included or quoted separately. Review projects relevant to your own type of customer before choosing on visual style alone. Explore TheBomb's website services.

A Kelowna web-design shortlist should start with the business problem and the kind of work required. Choose providers whose demonstrated services match that brief, then ask each to respond to the same scope.

  • Name the priority services and the customer action the site needs to support.
  • Identify the content and images you already have.
  • List booking, payment or CRM requirements.
  • Ask for account ownership, training and support terms.
  • Request a clear split between the build and ongoing marketing.

A considered proposal should explain the approach and assumptions. The website cost checklist helps compare what is included. The Kelowna website guide helps turn the business objective into a brief.

faqs: Is a freelancer or an agency better for a Kelowna business website?

Choose by scope and working style. A hands-on independent designer can suit a focused website and close collaboration; an agency can suit work needing several specialists or continuing team capacity. Send the same brief to each provider. Ask who will do the work, how approvals happen, what you will own and what support follows launch. Compare a relevant project and an editing demonstration rather than assuming team size determines quality.
Are all these designers physically based in Kelowna?

No. This shortlist serves Kelowna buyers and includes providers elsewhere in the Okanagan. Michael McKerracher is based in Coldstream. Keep a provider’s office location separate from the areas it serves. If face-to-face access matters, confirm where meetings happen and how often. Compare relevant work, availability and ongoing support alongside location.
Who should I choose if I also need branding, video or automation?

Include each requirement in the brief before requesting quotes. Michael McKerracher offers website design, branding, video, marketing and AI implementation. Ask each provider for deliverables and relevant examples for the services you need. Confirm what is delivered directly, what involves partners and who coordinates the handoffs. A combined proposal should still make the individual scopes and ongoing responsibilities clear.
What should I ask a Kelowna web designer before signing?

Ask for a relevant project, the proposed page structure, who writes the copy and how enquiries will be tested. Confirm platform and account ownership, redirects, analytics access and ongoing support. Request a clear list of exclusions and milestones so the proposal describes the work rather than relying on a polished portfolio alone.
Can I see a direction for my website before committing to a full build?

Michael offers a free custom homepage design preview with no obligation to hire him. It gives you a visual direction to discuss before agreeing to the complete website scope. Full packages start at CAD $2,500; the preview does not replace a written agreement about pages, content, integrations, hosting and support.
method: I’m Michael McKerracher, a web designer and marketing consultant based in Coldstream. I publish this comparison and include my own business. The recommendations below are my assessment of project fit, based on the firms’ public services and portfolio information reviewed on October 10, 2026. Compare the current scope and terms directly with each provider.
